description: Stored vector rows should be joined to source object embedding text by embedding id before object_embedding SQL is emitted.
Rows whose vector dimensions do not match the canonical Postgres vector column should be rejected before load SQL is emitted.
The planner should write reviewable side-effect-free SQL and operator commands without connecting to a live database.
Each accepted row should preserve embedding id, subject id, subject type, model, text hash, dimensions, runtime, storage backend, and worker metadata.
